messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: pagerduty incident fired — policy=latency-p99-inference-eu, current p99=1420ms (SLO burn)

pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: Incident #PD-7824 triggered for service Redwood Inference (latency-p99-inference-eu) — unacked

maria: acked on PD, jumping in. seeing p95 ~650ms, p99 ~1420ms across eu-west. no obvious error rates. customers seeing slow responses but not 500s.

devon: noted. grabbing hotpath traces. can someone confirm if autoscaler is healthy? `kubectl get hpa -n inference`

sachin: HPA looks okay, replicas at 12, cpu ~48%. tail latencies spiking, looks like KV-cache thrash on a subset of pods. logs show many cache misses: `kvcache.miss_rate ~ 0.78`

oliver: is this localized to a zone? I see higher latencies from eu-west-2a. maybe hotkey or uneven routing.

maria: good call. running a quick histogram from tracing to see distribution by node.

devon: while that runs, can we suppress autopager if it's a noisy transient? PD policy firing threshold is 5 min p99>1s. This is steady for ~3 mins. i'd avoid suppress.

sachin: agreed. mitigation plan: 1) pin traffic away from the problematic AZ, 2) enable fallback model variant (smaller) for non-critical routes, 3) open ticket for kv-cache eviction tuning.

maria: routing change: adding temporary route rule to avoid eu-west-2a -> applying now:
```
# traffic rule
PATCH /routing/policies/active
{"avoid_zones":["eu-west-2a"]}
```

oliver: routing change applied. monitoring p99...

status-bot: Canary telemetry: p99 dropped from 1420ms -> 920ms in 40s after route change. p95 stable ~610ms.

devon: good improvement. next: fallback model rollout for non-SLA customers. will flip traffic 10% to smaller model.

sachin: rolling fallback at 10% now. watch logs for quality regressions.

maria: PD update: acknowledged -> assigned to @maria. severity remains P2 (SLO burn). updating internal incident ticket INF-2026.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident #PD-7824 acknowledged by maria. Escalation paused.

oliver: can we confirm customer impact? any error reports from support?

maria: support reported slowdowns for 3 customers (mid-size) but no functional failures. shipping a status note to keep them informed.

status-bot: Draft status update suggested:
"We are investigating elevated inference latency in EU. A subset of requests are experiencing increased tail latency. Mitigation steps are underway and customer-facing impact is limited to slower responses. No data loss or errors reported."

maria: posting status update now.

devon: ops note: we'll keep autoscales as-is; prefer routing+fallback over adding more cores for now. need action item for kv-cache tuning.

sachin: opened INF-2026-01 for kv-cache eviction policy + hotkey detection. assigned to infra-ml. ETA tomorrow.

oliver: if p99 climbs above 1600ms or errors start appearing, escalate to P1 and loop oncall-sre. otherwise continue triage and monitor.

maria: understood. i'll stay on this for next 30m then hand off to devon for rotation. leaving ack.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident #PD-7824 acknowledged by maria at 2026-03-15T14:10:22Z

incident-bot: Note: no follow-up autopage needed for 20 minutes after ack per policy.

devon: i'll pick up after maria. current p99=880ms. leaving handoff notes in INF-2026. :thumbsup:

maria: handoff complete. closing slack thread for now — will re-open if metrics degrade. :white_check_mark:
